80139.subject: Is Robinhood Chain Over?
80139.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

One of the most talked about topics this summer was the blistering success of [Robinhood Chain](https://app.blockworks.com/report/robinhood-chain-can-it-move-robinhood-s-bottom-line), which, after launching on July 1, quickly became one of the leading blockchains for onchain activity. However, in recent weeks, this activity has largely pulled back, and [many](https://x.com/stacy_muur/status/2104563177702949274?s=20) are now wondering if Robinhood Chain was simply just a flash in the pan. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/f6ab1ee2-ff05-4848-9686-0ab755d97897/image.png?t=1790945846)
Caption: 

The weakness on Robinhood Chain in September is perhaps best observed amongst the three largest Robinhood native tokens by market cap, [PONS](https://app.blockworks.com/projects/pons-launchpad), [CASHCAT](https://app.blockworks.com/projects/cash-cat), and [AI](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/artificial-inu-3?chart=type%3Dmarket_cap%26mode%3Dline%26timeframe%3Dmax), respectively. After repricing in late August and early September, all three tokens have been in a downward chop over the last few weeks. Since September 1, AI is down 34% and CASHCAT is down 23%. Granted, PONS is still up 20% from September 1, but at its current price of $0.526, it is down 45% from its high of $0.96. Amongst the ecosystem leaders on Robinhood, there is notable weakness, especially when compared to how the rest of crypto performed in the latter half of September. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8aebb734-449e-4224-83e1-4cc59af6f909/image.png?t=1790945845)
Caption: 

This weakness has extended far beyond just the top three tokens on Robinhood Chain, and it can be observed in the chain’s bottom line as well. Daily network REV is back at levels seen before Robinhood Chain’s ‘mania’ in late August and early September. To be fair, part of this decline is due to Robinhood increasing gas limits onchain, thereby overstating the decline from the top. Regardless, Robinhood Chain is showing the classic telltale signs of an onchain ‘bust.’ 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/cead7cfa-3160-4274-9a9a-fdb51b74d9ca/image.png?t=1790945846)
Caption: 

The reason that this onchain weakness is concerning is that healthy and sustainable speculative activity may be the key for Robinhood Chain’s long-term success. 🧠 Crypto News Brief: Soft US jobs data and fading Fed-hike bets lifted Bitcoin toward $87K, while regulators in Washington and Brussels advanced crypto rulebooks and institutions from Tokyo to Tether pushed deeper into on-chain finance. 📊 Weak US Jobs Report Lifts Bitcoin Toward $87K The US added just 29,000 jobs in September, far below the roughly 90,000 economists expected, while unemployment ticked up to 4.2% and August was revised down to 133,000. Bitcoin held its gains and traded just under $87,000 as markets slashed the odds of an October Fed hike to about 13%. Derivatives traders had already piled in: open interest climbed by roughly $2.3 billion since Sept. 30, and perpetual funding rates rose from about 3% to 10%. Read full story → 🏛️ SEC Proposes Crypto Custody Rules as Peirce Exits The Securities and Exchange Commission proposed a dedicated custody framework for registered investment advisers and regulated funds holding crypto. Advisers could act as custodians themselves in limited cases, such as when no permitted custodian exists for an asset, and state-chartered trust companies would qualify as custodians. Chair Paul Atkins said the plan creates a compliant pathway where none existed. A 60-day comment period opens after Federal Register publication. The proposal lands as Commissioner Hester Peirce, architect of the Crypto Task Force, departs on Friday, leaving the SEC with only two commissioners. More details → 🇸🇻 IMF Waives El Salvador's Bitcoin Breach, Releases $139M The IMF board completed the second and third reviews of El Salvador's $1.4 billion loan program and released roughly $139 million, granting a waiver even though the country breached its limit on Bitcoin accumulation. The Fund accepted documentation that the extra coins came from private donations rather than public money, but said no further accumulation is envisaged beyond documented gifts. The program also requires a smaller state role in the Chivo wallet, now majority-controlled by a private operator. Read more → 💵 Tether's USDT Is Coming Home to Bitcoin Tether's USDT, which first launched on Bitcoin's Omni Layer in 2014 before migrating to Ethereum and Tron, is set to return to Bitcoin this month.
